Challenge, growth opportunities, and a good salary of €18,83 as a delivery driver at Albert Heijn, you get it all! 🚀🤑 Every day is different, with new routes and obstacles, which makes your job challenging and fun! And, there is a lot in return. Think of the many happy faces of customers when you arrive with your delivery van at their doorstep! 🚚

Curious about what other benefits you can expect? Read on! 👀

What we offer
- Earn € 18,83 per hour (from age 21)!
- A chance to get a contract with Albert Heijn!
- An informal work environment!
- Plan your own shifts via the app!
- Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, up to 45 km!
- Nice growth opportunities at Albert Heijn!

Who you are
As a delivery driver, your social skills come in very handy: you will be in touch with customers a lot! 😊 Also, physical work is no problem for you, such as lifting crates up to fifteen kilos. 💪 Additionally, you meet the following requirements:

- You have a valid B driving license (Min 2 Year)🚗
- You speak Dutch or English, or both
- You have transport to get to our location at Siegenstraat 7 in Zwolle 🚗🚲

What will you do
As a delivery driver, you will deliver groceries at customers' houses! 🍉🥦🧀 Also, you complete the payments and take empty bottles with you. While driving around in your own van, you may encounter challenges. Like a building without an elevator or a hard-to-find house number. This makes your work varied and exciting! #baanrader 🤩 Fortunately, you’ll be well-prepared: you start your job with an extensive training guided by a buddy. This colleague will teach you exactly how to deliver groceries on time and neatly. 💪 Ready for more? You can grow internally to become a buddy or a team leader through internal training programs. 🚀

Where will you work

As our new Reach Truck Driver in venlo, you are a motivated team player who ticks the following boxes

To top it off, you will help out with inventory tracking and take care of physical tasks like restacking heavy pallets up to 15 kg!

Besides the fact that you have no problems getting up early and understanding and speaking the English language. You are also able to:

As a warehouse employee, you are together with your colleagues, responsible for the stocking of the packages. But, what does this actually entail? Trucks arrive full of parcels. Do you have questions about this or is something not working? There is always an assistant team leader around to help you.

- working hours from 05:30/07.00 till 12:00

Together with your colleagues, you fulfill the function of a warehouse employee in Elst. The team consists of super nice and friendly colleagues from a specific target group. You can laugh very hard with everyone. But of course, we also work hard. A good combination that makes the time fly by!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you, as a warehouse employee, meet the following requirements:

- You speak Dutch and/or English.
- You have your own transport.
- You are physically able to lift boxes up to 20 kilos if necessary.
- You are available within a week.
- Full-time available
- Available in 2 shifts.
- You can work in Venlo.
- You have your own accomodation.

What will you do
Are you going to work as a warehouse worker at DSV? Then you get started with an English voice picking system! You will be told via this system which products you need to collect. You will also be told which location to take this to! You take the products and stack them on a pallet. Then you seal it closed. Everything is ready to ship! As an order picker you are very flexible. You don't mind helping out in another department every now and then! One team, one task! Do you also want to continue growing after a while? That's possible! Who knows, you might end up being the new team leader! :)

- Workdays: Monday to Friday.
- Worktimes: in two shifts from 6:00 AM to 3:00 PM and from 3:00 PM to 12:00 AM.

Where will you work
As a warehouse worker at DSV, you will work in a large warehouse. This location can be found at Popeweg 50 in Venlo. Do you have your own car, scooter or bicycle? This makes the location easy to reach! You also occasionally work at different locations. But luckily you are flexible! You don't work alone in this large warehouse, but with a super fun team!
